led-exception`. Four real customer requests failed before the investigation even started; a fresh probe at the end reproduced the identical failure, so it's still live. All three lenses ran in parallel: `infra-process` and `interfaces` found nothing in their domains (clean single startup, no chaos, no malformed requests), and the adversarial judge validated the hypothesis, with one honestly-flagged gap — telemetry can't confirm *when* the stock hit zero, so "no deploys that we know of" is unaddressed rather than disproven.

Journal written to `journals/2026-11-02-product-3-zero-stock-500s.md`.
